readme:
# YouTube Transcriber

Extracts transcripts from YouTube videos with intelligent fallback. First attempts to get available captions, then falls back to downloading audio and using OpenRouter's Whisper model for transcription.

## Features

- **Smart Caption Detection**: Tries to extract available YouTube captions first (fast, free)
- **Audio Fallback**: Downloads audio and transcribes via OpenRouter's Whisper model
- **Multi-language Support**: Portuguese, English, and more
- **Efficient Storage**: Returns clean transcript text

## Input

Provide the following JSON:

```json
{
  "youtubeUrl": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zw_e_vVTq4Y",
  "openRouterApiKey": "sk-xxx"
}
```

## Input Fields

- **youtubeUrl** (string, required): Full YouTube URL or short link
- **openRouterApiKey** (string, optional): Your OpenRouter API key. Required if video has no captions.

## Output

Success case:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "youtubeUrl": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zw_e_vVTq4Y",
  "videoId": "zw_e_vVTq4Y",
  "transcript": "Full transcript text here...",
  "provider": "youtube-transcript",
  "language": "pt",
  "generatedAt": "2024-01-01T10:00:00.000Z"
}
```

Or via OpenRouter:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "youtubeUrl": "...",
  "videoId": "...",
  "transcript": "...",
  "provider": "openrouter",
  "usage": { "input_tokens": 1234, "output_tokens": 567 },
  "generatedAt": "..."
}
```

## Getting API Keys

- **OpenRouter**: Sign up at [openrouter.ai](https://openrouter.ai) and get your key

## Limitations

- Videos longer than ~2 hours may be split
- OpenRouter transcription is metered (pay per token)
- Some videos may be age-restricted or region-blocked
